segments.normalizedSource: ```swift import UIKit import StoreKit class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate { .... // Attach an observer to the payment queue. func application(_ application: UIApplication, didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplicationLaunchOptionsKey: Any]?) -> Bool { SKPaymentQueue.default().add(iapObserver) return true } // The system calls this when the app is about to terminate. func applicationWillTerminate(_ application: UIApplication) { // Remove the observer. SKPaymentQueue.default().remove(iapObserver) } .... } ```
